# Acme rate card

## Overview

This rate card lists what Acme pays for design and build work in 2026. Rates are per hour and exclude VAT.

## Rates

Hourly rates by role:

| Role | Hourly rate (EUR) |
| --- | --- |
| Senior designer | 160 |
| Designer | 120 |
| Developer | 140 |
| Project manager | 110 |

## Terms

Invoices are due within thirty days. Travel is billed at cost.
